properties.name: rule
properties.description: CSS Gap Decorations: shorthand for row-rule/column-rule width, style, and colour — draws lines in the gaps between grid/flex items. Limited browser support as of 2026.

properties.name: rule-break
properties.description: CSS Gap Decorations: controls whether gap rule lines break at grid item intersections (e.g. "intersection", "spanning-item"). Limited browser support as of 2026.

properties.name: rule-inset
properties.description: CSS Gap Decorations: insets gap rule lines from the edges of the items they run between. Limited browser support as of 2026.
